paragraphs: I'm applying for the Data Analytics Product Management internship in the MTA's Spring Emerging Talent program. I'm an MBA (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The chance to work on data products for a transit system millions of New Yorkers use every day is a real draw for me.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I built cross-platform analytics frameworks to track campaign KPIs, which helped deliver a 135% increase in engagements while cutting media spend by up to 83%. At Lenovo I documented business requirements and turned stakeholder needs into dashboards that improved campaign ROI by 20%, and I owned the mapping and QA for AI-powered dashboards that saved the team 4+ hours a week on reporting.
That mix of gathering requirements, checking the data and making it usable for decision makers is what I'd bring to your team. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the MTA's Data Analytics Product Management Emerging Talent internship this spring. At Lenovo I documented business requirements and turned stakeholder needs into dashboards that improved campaign ROI by 20%. I'd love to hear what the team is building. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
